hook: iOS Safari caps your web app at 60 FPS

beats.say: On 120 hertz iPhones, WebKit limits requestAnimationFrame and touch events to 60 hertz, which makes even great mobile websites feel sluggish.
Rida F'kih's trick is to use native scroll areas, which run on the compositor thread, as the input source for animations.
Scroll events only arrived 5 to 26 times a second during momentum, so he built a separate controller to read scroll position fast enough to feel native.
